warnings.message: Dim light: 85% of photos at high ISO (median 2997). Switch on all lights - sharper photos, better colour.
The phone was hot ('serious') for 410 of 410 photos; iOS may lower camera quality. Let it cool between scans.
The LiDAR measured only 36% of the ceiling. Sweep the ceiling from closer, pointing the phone up.
Phone tracking: 2 gap(s) over 2 s (longest 10.3 s). Check that part of the model.
